question: Who among the following sportspersons is an Indian professional tennis player?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Rohan Bopanna.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A** professional tennis player** from** India **is Rohan Bopanna.
 
• His highes**t singles career ranking was 213 in 2007**, and his **highest doubles career ranking **was **3 on July 22, 2013**.
 
• Since 2002, he has competed for** India in the Davis Cup.**
 
• The **2011 and 2012 Paris Masters,** the **2015 Madrid Open,** and the 2017 Monte Carlo Masters are the** four Masters 1000 men's doubles** competitions that the Indian has won.
 
• In** 2012 and 2015,** he competed in the **ATP World Tour Finals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prakash Padukone:**

 
 
• A **former Indian badminton playe**r is Prakash Padukone. He topped the world rankings in **1980.**
 
 
 
• **Pullela Gopichand:**
 
 
• **A former Indian badminton player** is Pullela Gopichand. He currently serves as the **India national badminton team's Chief National Coach.**
 
 
 
• **Kuldeep Yadav:**
 
 
• **Indian cricketer **Kuldeep Yadav competes for both **India and Uttar Pradesh in domestic competition.**
